full_prompt_en: The square image is an expressive mixed-media portrait of a middle-aged man with tousled grey-white curls and a full beard, set against a pale paper-like ground. His head and shoulders occupy the centre, with the face turned slightly to the right while his sharp eyes look directly toward the viewer. Thick brows, a straight nose and a firm mouth are described with layered strokes of warm brown, charcoal and pale grey. The beard spreads across the lower face in irregular white and grey masses, with darker marks defining the moustache and the shadow beneath the lower lip. Curly hair lifts away from the forehead and temples, its pale strands broken by charcoal strokes and soft smudges. Around the head, loose grey marks and faint crosshatching blend into a nearly white background. Thin linear scratches and fragments of pale printed-looking texture remain visible beneath the portrait, though no wording can be read. At the lower edge, a high cream-white shirt collar frames the neck; a narrow deep brown area sits inside the opening, while the outer clothing remains mostly cropped and indistinct. The face is built from broad, slightly fragmented planes, with warm tan and ochre across the cheeks and cooler grey near the temples and beard. Several edges appear rubbed or erased, especially around the hairline and shoulders, giving the paper surface a visibly worked quality. Light falls softly from the front-left, illuminating the brow, nose and upper cheek while leaving a muted shadow under the beard and along the far side of the face. The portrait remains direct and contained, without props or a defined setting. The beard’s outer contour breaks into feathery pale strokes, while denser charcoal marks gather beneath the mouth and along the jaw. The hairline is irregular, with loose curls lifted against the pale ground and a few darker strands crossing the temple. The shirt collar opens around the neck in two crisp folded edges, its warm inner shadow separating it from the beard. Subtle linework continues into the background but remains secondary to the direct gaze. The brightest marks remain on the forehead, cheek and collar edge. The shirt remains brighter than the inner collar shadow, while most of the outer garment merges with the lower crop. The overall composition balances the dense dark features and beard against the open pale ground, using loose marks, restrained earth tones and a focused gaze to create an introspective, painterly presence.
full_prompt_zh: 这是一幅方形、富有表现力的混合媒介肖像，描绘一名灰白卷发、蓄着浓密胡须的中年男子，背景像浅色纸面。他的头肩占据中央，面部略微转向右侧，锐利目光直视观者。浓眉、直鼻和紧抿嘴唇由暖棕、炭灰与浅灰色层叠笔触刻画。胡须以不规则白灰色块覆盖下半张脸，较深笔痕勾出上唇胡和下唇下方阴影。卷曲头发从额头与太阳穴周围蓬松翘起，浅色发丝间穿插炭黑笔迹和柔化污痕。头部周围，松散灰色痕迹与淡淡交叉排线融进近乎白色的背景。细线刮痕和近似浅色印刷痕的碎片留在肖像下方，但无法读出任何文字。画面下缘，一圈奶白色高领衬衣围住颈部；衣领开口内侧有一条窄窄的深棕色区域，外衣大部分被裁切且难以辨清。面部由略显断裂的宽色面组成，面颊铺有暖褐与赭色，太阳穴和胡须附近则偏冷灰。发际与肩部周围有几处边缘像被擦抹或擦除，使纸面显出反复处理的质感。光线从左前方柔和照来，提亮眉骨、鼻子和上面颊，胡须下方与脸部远侧则留有含蓄阴影。肖像直接而收敛，没有道具或明确场景。胡须外缘由羽状浅色笔痕断续勾出，嘴下和下颌沿线则聚集较密的炭色笔迹。发际不规则，松卷发丝从浅色底面前翘起，几缕较深发束掠过太阳穴。衬衣领在颈部两侧翻开，形成清楚折边，内侧暖影将它与胡须分开。细线痕继续延伸到背景，却仍次于直接的目光。最亮的笔痕仍集中在额头、面颊与衣领边缘。衬衣亮于衣领内侧阴影，大部分外衣则融入画面下缘的裁切处。整体构图以密集的深色五官和胡须平衡开阔浅色底面，通过松散痕迹、克制土色和专注目光形成内省的绘画气息。
style_prompt_en: The mixed-media rendering combines loose drawing, rubbed passages and layered colour planes on a pale ground. Warm earth tones meet charcoal and cool grey, while broken edges keep the surface from feeling overly polished. Fine scratches and crosshatched marks remain visible around broader areas of soft modelling. Light is diffuse and selective, preserving a few clear highlights against a largely quiet background. The overall treatment feels tactile and introspective, balancing firm dark accents with open space and weathered surface texture.
style_prompt_zh: 混合媒介表现把松散线描、擦抹痕迹和层叠色面结合在浅色底面上。暖土色与炭黑、冷灰相接，断续边缘避免表面显得过分光滑。细刮痕和交叉排线留在宽阔柔和塑形的周围。光线漫射且有选择性，在大体安静的背景前保留少量清晰高光。整体处理可触而内省，以明确深色强调平衡留白与风化表面肌理。
theme_en: Grey-haired bearded man in a cream collar against a scratched pale ground
theme_zh: 浅色刮痕底面前穿奶白高领的灰发胡须男子
name: Gary Benfield
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
